title: A Network's ten central admins are its operator seats, the pricing table shows a sibling plan's own number, and /features carries a Collective and Network group

source.ref: Full scan 2026-10-19 (/mnt/project-files/scan/2026-10-19-full-scan: P2 Network seats fall back to Collective's 3; marketing P2 8, /features has no Collective or Network features). Owner ruling 2026-10-19: fan out and build everything.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19. PREMISE RE-TESTED: space_team had no network number, so allowanceAt('space_team','network') read Collective's rung (3) while /pricing and the Network card promise ten central admins; the day beta grace ends (2026-12-01) a Network with more than three operators would be over its licence. The table had a second gap: meterCell read a tier's rung by rank, so a sibling plan the row names (Non Profit's 5 QR codes, now Network's 10 seats) showed the rung's number, not its own. Fix: space_team names network: 10 (pinned to NETWORK_PLAN.centralAdmins by test); siblingAllowanceText in feature-meters.ts returns a named sibling's own line and meterCell reads it first; the seats meter carries a Network line. /features: a Grow together job under For spaces with Partner hub (Collective) and Chapters (Network), each linking its help article through FEATURE_FALLBACK.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];if(!/space_team: \\{[^}]*network: 10/.test(r('lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts')))miss.push('space_team names no Network number');if(!/export function siblingAllowanceText/.test(r('lib/pricing/feature-meters.ts')))miss.push('no sibling allowance read');if(!/siblingAllowanceText\\(feature, column\\.tier\\)/.test(r('lib/pricing/pricing-grid.ts')))miss.push('the table ignores a sibling number');const f=r('components/frequency/site/pages/features/features-data.ts');if(!/tier: 'Collective'/.test(f)||!/tier: 'Network'/.test(f))miss.push('/features has no Collective or Network feature');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-992: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
